scope: Read complete Japanese premise,11 turns,5 task hints and all12 locale sentence/task sets. No cross-worker semantic review.
reviewCriteria: Direction does not establish train final stop; Teine-ending service alone cannot reach Otaru. Preserve no-transfer preference and willingness to wait; rapid service stopping is unconfirmed until checked. Match destination,time,name on same board row and check same train at boarding platform before getting on.

Cosmetics: existing red cheeks means defer trying and buying, low-irritation label does not guarantee personal suitability. Shared ingredients do not establish cause; record labels, symptoms and usage dates for professional consultation before deciding on use.

Used washing machine: apparent installation width alone is insufficient; stairs, entrance turn and delivery route remain unchecked. Do not substitute incompatible parts; inspect hoses, taps and drain connection. No purchase or reservation is confirmed. Compare condition,accessories,operation,warranty,return terms and delivery costs after measuring.

Night-shift prescription: morning is an unresolved medication-specific timing question, not automatically waking time. Identify OTC product from box photo and disclose unconfirmed information before combinations. Write work/meals, use teach-back, ask how to seek advice for missed dose/shift changes. No independent dose or morning reinterpretation.

Beginner ski rental: equipment does not establish permission/ability for same terrain as skilled friend; instruction and participation conditions checked separately. Personal fit not friend equipment; pain and binding adjustment to staff. If participation guidance unavailable return to observing; booking and cancellation/return conditions precede commitment.

Tax records: annual deposits include two employers while paper covers current employer only after July switch. Business-trip reimbursement shares salary date but is not classified by date alone. Match employer/period,payslips,bank records,reimbursement copies; missing copy triggers employer inquiry,never guessed subtraction. Whether tax document correction needed remains consultation after facts confirmed.

Sightseeing boat: departure time was mistaken for return; request same boarding/return point and schedule margin. Friend personally checks seats/waiting and intermediate exit; departure/return may change and arbitrary disembarkation is not guaranteed. Buy only after explanation fits return plan; otherwise skip and return another day. Onboard illness contact remains staff question.

Wood craft gift: initial same-day requirement changes after learning next-day finish. Ship after finishing, not guaranteed arrival next day. 1800 activity+500 shipping=2300 yen. Choose round/wave; learner draws draft only; cutting,drying,finishing,packing staff. Confirm address and application before draft instruction.

Coworker sweets: piece count distinct from individual wrapping; night-shift recipients receive later and may not eat immediately. Check actual product dates/storage including after outer box opening; if wrapper lacks date copy and pass outer-label information,not assume safety from box date alone. Distribute unopened individual wrappers and compare people/pieces before box quantity.

Science museum gears: apparently button-like part is staff-only,not permitted visitor operation. Count small-gear rotations during one large-gear rotation,then examine direction; demonstrated result two rotations/opposite. Watch outside viewing line without touching,staff controls. Short explanation and written observation-order teach-back requested.

Attraction queue with overnight backpack too large at feet: luggage handling and original-position reentry must be checked,not assumed. Do not leave unannounced; friend waiting and requeuing acceptable fallback. Ticket not yet handed over,registration status unconfirmed; staff checks cancellation/use terms before player decides ride versus wait.

Muroran move-in: mover slip is not municipal moving-out document. Prior consultation does not prove completed procedure. Show instruction email/residence card,determine missing document names and specific inquiry at competent counter,then contact previous municipality. No generic document sufficiency or completed registration asserted.

Hospital first visit: symptoms since last night and worsened weakness after walking relayed before forms; appointment belongs other hospital,not automatically current reception. Patient cannot judge waiting tolerance,requests seat/medical staff. Show My Number/residence cards and other-hospital screen,confirm reception process; changes immediately reported. No confirmed appointment or clinical diagnosis invented.

Lost wallet: initial supermarket assumption corrected after finding phone payment; last confirmed wallet use morning drink before station. Brown corner scratch,bank card confirmed; residence card presumed home remains unconfirmed not declared lost. Separate confirmed contents,route and callable times; contact bank issuer separately,ask followup if unable answer. No found wallet or card freeze presumed.

Domestic parcel: clothes+portable charger declared despite sealed box. Type/battery/terminals/packaging and acceptance unresolved until staff checks model photo; clothes wrapping alone not approved. Ask permitted work area,consider removing charger if verification unavailable,update declaration on content change,then recheck size/weight,recipient and fee before handover. No postal battery rule or automatic acceptance invented.

Bank name fields: surname SILVA COSTA, given names ANA MARIA copied exactly from identification,not workplace short Ana. COSTA neither omitted nor moved to given name. Submit verified account registered spelling to employer,keep nickname distinct. Filled name fields confirmed but other conditions pending; no account approval inferred.

Tofu shopping: usual photo product availability not known; stirfry substitution conditional on softness/firmness and storage label. Prior room-temperature carton only thought tofu,not all products share storage. Check current product label and store restock if available; unknown restock means consider alternative ingredients rather than commit waiting. No blanket tofu storage advice.

Park rest: wet bench does not permit flower-bed entry or sitting edge. Notice permits eating/drinking right of entrance information board in marked rest area off path; no bins,take rubbish home in carried bag. Standing drink fallback if usable bench distant,not doorway obstruction. Keep left/right,marked area and no-flower-bed instruction consistent.

Kushiro station: initial reservation arrival Kushiro vs another departure station read backward. Companion controls group booking,inside/outside gate initially unknown. Stay outside until new correct Kushiro departure T-6 and outside meeting confirmed; match same train display platform2,meet companion then verify current reservation/day display before gate entry. Values are scenario facts,not verified real timetable.

Resident-record copy: employer email specifies individual-only and no Individual Number. Registered domicile unspecified,do not add by assumption; confirm domicile/relationship before finishing form. Unknown 世帯主・続柄 label read setainushi/tsuzukigara; ask name/meaning and identity check. Recipient employer not submitting party. No full-family disclosure or completed application presumed.
